selection_rule: Report the Pareto frontier. Prefer the fastest method within 0.002 mean IoU of the highest development score. Freeze the final method and parameters before full-corpus scoring; no per-image or per-conversion method selection.
stopping_rule: Develop in documented rounds. After initial hypotheses, pursue genuinely distinct responses to observed failure modes. Stop after two consecutive rounds produce no new accuracy/speed Pareto improvement (accuracy tolerance 0.001 mean IoU, speed tolerance 5%), or when remaining ideas need different RGB inputs/new external supervision. This is a finite exploratory search, not a claim that innovation is exhausted.

hypotheses.B21: Whiten converted RGB with a shared covariance estimated from all original known coarse tissue. Use equal-prior linear discriminants and continuous tile-center reliability; all tissue may change. No fixed margin, frozen interior or hard seed.
hypotheses.B22: Invert the known RGB probability palette directly when affine identifiable. Otherwise solve nonnegative simplex colour reconstruction with a coarse-trained Bayesian colour prior, once per occupied 24-bin RGB lattice node. Apply bounded coarse correction only where posterior class separation is weak. No fixed margins or hard anchors; more than four dependent classes remain intrinsically ambiguous.
